events.text: The DRB Class 50 was built as a standard locomotive for hauling goods trains.
events.subject: self
events.quote: built from 1939 as a standard locomotive

events.text: The Deutsche Bundesbahn grouped the locomotives into Classes 050, 051, 052 and 053.

events.quote: grouped the locomotives into Classes 050 , 051 , 052 and 053 from 1968
